app.name: Sahayak
app.tagline: AI for public good — eight tools, built for the communities that need them most.

home.heading: One platform. Eight communities.
home.intro: Sahayak puts practical, offline-friendly AI in the hands of farmers, fishermen, artisans, vendors, students and citizens across India — in their own language.
home.hero: One trained model. Eight communities. Grounded answers, or none at all.
home.heroAccent: Grounded answers, or none at all.

status.scaffoldNote: Route stub — the module UI lands in a later commit.

farmers.name: Farmers
farmers.description: Diagnose crop disease from a photo, then get grounded treatment advice, mandi prices and weather-aware sowing tips.

fishermen.name: Fishermen
fishermen.description: Live sea conditions — wave height, wind and swell — turned into a plain-language go / no-go safety verdict.

artisans.name: Artisans & Small Producers
artisans.description: Photograph a product and get a listing title, description, fair price band and tags in your own language.

vendors.name: Micro-Entrepreneurs & Vendors
vendors.description: A daily demand and inventory note, a simple income–expense log, and a matcher for schemes you qualify for.

services.name: Public Services Navigator
services.description: Ask in plain language and find out which government schemes you are eligible for, grounded in curated official data.

accessibility.name: Persons with Disabilities
accessibility.description: Voice-first navigation plus large-text and high-contrast modes that carry across every module in Sahayak.

education.name: Rural Education
education.description: A patient doubt-solving tutor grounded on real NCERT chapter excerpts, with a citation for every answer.

disaster.name: Disaster & Climate Resilience
disaster.description: Hazard alerts for your district and an AI-generated preparedness checklist tailored to the threat.

disclaimer.adviceBody: Sahayak's guidance is a starting point, not an official ruling. Confirm eligibility, dosages and deadlines with the relevant department or a qualified professional before you act on it.
disclaimer.sampleBody: The figures on this screen are sample data for the prototype demo. They are not live readings.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.summary: Display and input settings. These apply across every module and are remembered on this device.
a11y.largeTextHint: Increases text size and spacing everywhere in Sahayak.
a11y.voiceModeHint: Ask your question by speaking, and hear the answer read back.
a11y.voicePending: Voice mode is on and your choice is saved, but speech input and output are not connected yet. Nothing on screen will read aloud until they are.
a11y.offlineModeHint: Simulates having no connection. Questions you have already asked in this session still answer instantly, from this device.
a11y.offlinePending: Offline mode is on. Nothing is being sent to the server — only questions already answered in this session can be shown.

auth.title: Sign in to Sahayak
auth.intro: Sign in with your mobile number so your logs, saved answers and settings stay on this device.
auth.demoBody: This is a prototype sign-in. No message is sent and no number is checked. Any 10-digit number and any 4 to 6 digit code will let you in, and the session is stored only in this browser.
auth.errorOtp: Enter a code of 4 to 6 digits.
auth.signInPrompt: Sign in to keep your work on this device.

chat.title: Ask a question
chat.intro: Answers come only from this module's reference data. If it is not in there, you will be told so.
chat.empty: No questions yet. Ask anything this module covers.
chat.errorOffline: Could not reach the server. Check that the backend is running.
chat.errorNotConfigured: The AI service isn't configured on the server, so answers cannot be generated yet.
chat.disclaimerBody: This module answers only from a small curated dataset, and that dataset is still placeholder content. Confirm anything important with the relevant department or a qualified person before acting on it.

fishermen: Is 1.8 metre wave height safe for a small boat?
What number do I call in an emergency at sea?
What is the price of fish in Kochi today?
accessibility: How do I make the text bigger?
Can I use Sahayak without a mouse?
What is the disability helpline number?
education: How do I add fractions with different denominators?
disaster: What should I keep ready before a flood?
What do I do during a cyclone?
services: Where can I check which schemes I am eligible for?
What documents do I usually need?
Am I eligible for a housing scheme?
farmers: My tomato leaves have brown spots — what should I do?
Who can confirm a crop disease?
What is the Kisan Call Centre number?
artisans: What makes a good product listing?
How should I price my work?
Can I use a GI craft name?
vendors: How do I work out what I really earn?
How do I reduce unsold stock?
What should I record each day?

chat.offlineMiss: You are in offline mode and this question has not been answered yet in this session. Turn offline mode off, or ask something you have already asked.
chat.sampleDataBody: This module answers from a small illustrative dataset written for the prototype. It has not been reviewed by a subject expert and is not live information. Check anything important with the relevant authority.

farmers.uploadDesc: Select or capture a clear photo of an infected crop leaf for AI diagnosis.

education.title: NCERT Science & Math Doubt Tutor
education.doubtPlaceholder: Enter your Science or Math question...

sea.title: Sea conditions
sea.intro: Live readings for a sample point offshore of your district, and what they mean for a small boat.
sea.verdictUnavailable: The readings above are live, but the plain-language verdict needs the AI service configured on the server.
sea.errorReadings: Could not load readings. Check that the backend is running and online.
sea.samplePoint: Sample point offshore — not a fishing ground.
sea.official: An INCOIS High Wave Alert or a Coast Guard warning overrides anything shown here. Emergency at sea: 1554.

listing.title: Photo to listing
listing.intro: Photograph what you made. You get a title, description, price band and tags you can paste straight into a marketplace.
listing.empty: No listing yet. Choose a photo to start.
listing.errorType: That file type is not supported. Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF.
listing.errorSize: That photo is too large. The limit is 5 MB.
listing.errorGeneric: The listing could not be generated. Try again.
listing.errorNotConfigured: The AI service isn't configured on the server, so listings cannot be generated yet.
listing.priceNote: An estimate to start from — check it against your own material and labour cost.
listing.disclaimerBody: This listing is generated from the photograph alone. Correct anything wrong about the material or size, and do not add a Geographical Indication craft name unless you are a registered producer for it.

vendor.logIntro: Enter what you took in and what your stock cost. After a few days you get a note about what to order tomorrow.
vendor.noEntries: No entries yet. Save your first day to start.
vendor.noteEmpty: Save at least one day, then ask for a note.
vendor.errorNumbers: Enter sales and stock cost as numbers.
vendor.errorNotConfigured: The AI service isn't configured on the server, so the note cannot be generated. Your log is still saved on this device.
vendor.errorGeneric: The note could not be generated. Try again.
vendor.localOnly: Your log is stored only on this device. Nothing is uploaded except the last 7 rows when you ask for a note.
vendor.schemeIntro: Answer four questions and see which schemes in the dataset you meet the rules for.
vendor.notMatched: You do not meet the rules for
vendor.noMatches: No scheme in the dataset matches this profile.
vendor.unverifiedBody: These are sample records with generic names. They do not describe any real government programme and their rules are illustrative. Check myScheme (myscheme.gov.in) or a Common Service Centre for what you are actually eligible for.

farmer.diagnoseIntro: Photograph an affected leaf. A trained image classifier runs on the server — this is not a guess from a chatbot.
farmer.noAdvice: Advice needs the AI service configured on the server. The classification above is from the model and stands on its own.
farmer.modelMissingBody: The classifier is wired up and ready, but no model file has been added yet, so no diagnosis can be made. Sahayak will not guess a disease name — a wrong spray costs a season. See backend/models/README.md.
farmer.errorType: That file type is not supported. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
farmer.errorSize: That photo is too large. The limit is 5 MB.
farmer.errorGeneric: The classifier could not run on this image.
farmer.empty: No result yet. Choose a photo to start.
farmer.disclaimerLabel: A photo cannot confirm a disease
farmer.disclaimerBody: Different diseases, nutrient deficiency and spray burn look alike in a photograph. Confirm with your Krishi Vigyan Kendra or an extension officer before spraying anything. Kisan Call Centre: 1800-180-1551.
farmer.mandiIntro: Today's rates from the government's Agmarknet feed.
farmer.noPrices: No rates reported for that crop today.
farmer.mandiRateLimited: data.gov.in is rate-limiting the shared demo key. Register a free key at data.gov.in and set DATA_GOV_IN_API_KEY in backend/.env.
farmer.sampleKeyBody: These rates are real and come from data.gov.in, but the request used the sample key published in their documentation. It is shared by every demo and will be throttled. Register a free key before relying on this.
farmer.unclearLowConfidence: The model is not confident enough about this photo to name a disease.
farmer.unclearAmbiguous: The model is split between two possibilities, so it cannot give you one answer.
farmer.unclearHelp: Try again in daylight, hold the camera steady, and fill the frame with a single affected leaf against a plain background.
farmer.flagThanks: Thanks, this helps us improve the model.
farmer.flagStored: Your photo and the prediction were saved so this case can be reviewed.
farmer.flagError: The report could not be sent. Try again.
farmer.serverUnreachableBody: The classifier could not be reached, so we cannot tell whether a model is installed. Check that the backend is running, then reload.
